methodology.cpu: Two passes in opposite framework order; ten samples per operation, twenty for selection; pinned harness warmups and throttling, no trimming.
methodology.memory: Three samples per state; pinned harness GC and page-memory estimator.
methodology.size: Entry JavaScript bytes and gzip bytes, including application code; excludes shared harness CSS.
methodology.limitations: One local machine and Chrome version; sessions run sequentially without concurrent builds/tests. System noise uncontrolled.

results.methodology: Pinned harness Lighthouse implementation and defaults; three fresh-browser runs per framework; no warmups.
